changed_factors: Attribution arm for the cell-quota probe: the candidate cell-quota-minimum-change-forward-kl-g-v1 recipe with every cell field and optimizer_signal_roles removed. Equals the BCAP DualNorm control except optimizer_family=nsgda_global, optimizer_convolution=none, optimizer_smoothing=0.
mechanism_rationale: Separates the optimizer swap (DualNorm per-offset -> global NSGDA) from the cell objective, so a ring16 failure of the cell-quota candidate can be attributed to one or the other. Opt-in research diagnostic only.
